g.text: Healthy service across TCP, QUIC and mixed paths
One shared 500 Mbps link · 70 ms DOWN / 30 ms UP · no injected loss or jitter · 25 s offered load
DOWN uses ordered receiver bytes; UP uses target-sink confirmations, including any settlement after 25 s. No UP echo probe exists.
One observation per version; no smoothing or variability bands. Defaults: prior 10%/10%; candidate 20%/20%.
Echo markers above the axis: × failed attempt, | unavailable; neither is a latency value. Exact samples/outcomes accompany the SVGs.
